142.measure_note: Landscape sheet rendered portrait: rows advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT (axis x). Measured on the RAW 200 dpi poppler render, not a deskewed copy. Row rules = the dark-column profile taken INSIDE the amount-column strip (y 5.5-15.5 pct, threshold 0.8), which keeps the page's ~0.4 deg skew from smearing them; column rules = the dark-row profile over x 20-80 pct. The detector's first three bands were TRIMMED as non-data: [6.91,9.35] outer margin, [9.35,12.50] HEADER ('Amount / Address / Name of Contributor / Date'), [12.50,15.53] the SHADED/HATCHED spacer band the form prints before the first data row (the 2026-08-18 addendum s2.2 defect). The 23 bands stored are the printed data rows, so row N resolves to rows[N-1]. cell is the AMOUNT column (the LAST printed column on Form A), listed first in cells because the rotated render puts it at the top. PROOF (2026-08-18): pct:15.53,5.20,3.15,10.71@p142 at 900 dpi --value rendered '$3,500 -' = the amount recorded for row 1 (first transcribed row), with the dotted shaded spacer visible immediately to its left; pct:40.79,5.20,3.15,10.71@p142 at 900 dpi --value rendered '$250' = the amount recorded for row 9 (last transcribed row). Neither rendered a neighbour's figure, so the band list is not off by one.

143.measure_note: Same method and same axis as p142. Trimmed as non-data: [6.71,9.15] outer margin, [9.15,16.24] the two-line HEADER ('Date of Expenditure' wraps, so this band is wider than p142's), [16.24,19.35] the SHADED/HATCHED spacer band -- which was caught by a crop, not by the detector: pct:16.24,4.27,3.11,10.68@p143 at 900 dpi --value rendered a solid DOTTED GREY FIELD and no figure, proving that band is the spacer and that the data rows start at 19.35. cells are, in render order, Amount / Purpose of Expenditure / City / Person-or-Organization / Date of Expenditure; cell is the Amount column. PROOF (2026-08-18): pct:19.35,4.27,3.09,10.68@p143 at 1200 dpi --value rendered '$3,2(slashed-0)(slashed-0) -' = 3,200.00, the amount recorded for row 1 (first transcribed row); pct:25.50,4.27,3.06,10.68@p143 at 900 dpi --value rendered '$1875 -' = 1,875.00, the amount recorded for row 3 (last transcribed row). Row 2 sits between them and its 1,666.67 is fixed by the schedule total.
